3263-5412-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5412-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5412-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

728-3249-5004-6006.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5004-6006.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

728-2459-3184.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2445-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

4067-5042-6827-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-5042-6827-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4359-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2811-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-2292-4871-6112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-3099-6006-6633.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6152.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Veteran Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

4050-7430--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.
4050-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

4186-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

252-1575-2921-5776.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4812-5231.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

730-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-4499-7009.manaNeeded: {6}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-4499-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2034-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-3227-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Scrivener.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

147-2511-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

1336-1636-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1336-1636-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

1329-3338-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

325-1786-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
325-1786-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
325-1786-6282.description:
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Toluz's second ability triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 if needed for each remaining trigger.
Discard down to your maximum hand size again, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat.

2815-3750-6473.easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
2815-3750-6473.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2815-3750-6473.description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating a token copy of Professional Face-Breaker that is tapped and attacking each opponent.
Deal combat damage with Mardu Siegebreaker and any number of Professional Face-Breaker token(s), triggering each Professional Face-Breaker, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate up to five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R} for each Treasure sacrificed this way.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
2815-3750-6473.notes: The combo assumes that each opponent and each Professional Face-Breaker will survive the first combat phase. The pre-requisites may vary if this is not the case. You may also perform this combo with less opponents but will require more mana. Once you have five Professional Face-Breaker tokens, this combo will break even.

238-2292-5756.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

654-2034-6188-6332--85.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
654-2034-6188-6332--85.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Fear of Missing Out.
Repeat each combat phase.

1657-2646.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1657-2646.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2533-2719-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1651-2034-2797.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

851-2178-4214-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
851-2178-4214-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

2021-3021.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked an opponent.
2021-3021.description:
Cast Conclave Sledge-Captain by paying {5}{G}.
When Conclave Sledge-Captain enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature with power 3 or greater, and causing it to gain the printed abilities until end of turn.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting a growth counter on it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Deal combat damage with the creature that was targeted in step 3, triggering the creature's ability three times.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the creature equal to the damage dealt.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting that many growth counters on it.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

1737-2544-3390-4893.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Activate the Lotus Bloom token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

944-4050-4504-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {B}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {B}{B}.
Repeat.

628-1242-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cinderhaze Wretch, adding one mana of any color.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

232-618-5200.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
232-618-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1209-1697-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Neheb and Hellkite Charger do not have summoning sickness.
Neheb and Hellkite Charger can not be blocked.
The amount of cards in library is a multiple of 7.
1209-1697-3398.description:
Attack with Neheb and Hellkite Charger.
Hellkite Charger triggers.
Pay {5}{R}{R} to the trigger, gaining an extra combat phase and untapping all creatures you control.
Neheb deals combat damage, triggering.
With Neheb trigger, discard 7 cards and draw 7 cards, discards Kozilek when able, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
End combat.
Repeat.

751-3314-4093.notablePrerequisites: Land you control that can produce {U}.
751-3314-4093.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Mana Breach and Chulane triggers.
Resolve the Mana Breach trigger, returning a land to your hand.
Resolve the Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
